title: Our new neighbour / What will he do?
subtitle: 我们的新邻居 / 他将做什么？

lead.question: 如果你的新邻居是位飞行员，一年飞遍大半个地球——你会怎么用英语描述他「过去在哪里、现在在哪里、将来去哪里」？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。这一课是一篇短小的记叙文，三种时态在几句话里轮番登场：He was in the R.A.F.（他曾在皇家空军任职——过去时）；At the moment, he's in Madrid.（现在他在马德里——一般现在时）；He will fly to New York next month.（下个月他将飞往纽约——将来时）。注意时间状语是时态的路标：a week ago 配过去，next month / the month after next / the week after next 配将来。读完后想想：为什么说他幸运，他妻子却「不很幸运」？
goals: 熟记与一般将来时连用的时间短语：next month, the month after next, the week after next, in a year's time 等
会用 He will fly to / return to + 地点 描述行程
理解 has already been to（已经去过）与一般过去时 flew to 的区别
会用 next-door neighbour, at the moment, stay at home 等短语描述生活
lead.summary: 第 93 课介绍新邻居希尔先生（奈杰尔）：他是飞行员，曾在皇家空军任职；下个月飞纽约，再下个月飞东京；现在人在马德里，是一星期前飞去西班牙的，下下个星期返回伦敦。他只有 41 岁，却已去过世界上几乎每一个国家——可惜妻子运气没那么好，通常只能待在家里。第 94 课操练将来时问答与否定更正：He will go to New York next week. / No, Helen won't return to Geneva next year. She'll return to Bombay.
lead.tips: ① after next 表示「下下个」：the month after next 下下个月、the week after next 下下个星期；② 一般过去时用 last（last week），将来时用 next（next month），别混；③ has been to 表示「去过（已回来）」，has gone to 表示「去了（还没回来）」；④ already「已经」多用于肯定句，常放在 have/has 之后；⑤ R.A.F. = the Royal Air Force 皇家空军，读字母名。

questions.q: Why is Nigel a lucky man?
questions.zh: 为什么说奈杰尔很幸运？
questions.a: Because he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
questions.aZh: 因为他已经去过世界上几乎每一个国家。
questions.hint: 听 forty-one years old 后面那句。

questions.q: What is Mr Hill's job? Where was he before?
questions.zh: 希尔先生是做什么工作的？他以前在哪里任职？
questions.a: He's a pilot. He was in the R.A.F. (the Royal Air Force).
questions.aZh: 他是飞行员，曾在皇家空军任职。

questions.q: Where is he at the moment, and when did he fly to Spain?
questions.zh: 他现在在哪里？他什么时候飞去西班牙的？
questions.a: He's in Madrid at the moment. He flew to Spain a week ago.
questions.aZh: 他现在在马德里，是一星期以前飞到西班牙的。
questions.hint: 一个现在时，一个过去时。

questions.q: When will he fly to New York and Tokyo, and when will he return to London?
questions.zh: 他什么时候飞纽约和东京？什么时候返回伦敦？
questions.a: New York next month, Tokyo the month after next; he will return to London the week after next.
questions.aZh: 下个月飞纽约，再下个月飞东京；下下个星期返回伦敦。
questions.hint: 注意 next month / the month after next / the week after next。

questions.q: Why isn't his wife very lucky? What does this tell us about his job?
questions.zh: 为什么他的妻子「不很幸运」？这说明了飞行员这份工作的什么特点？
questions.a: Because she usually stays at home while her husband flies around the world. A pilot is away most of the time, so the family can't travel together. 参考答案：因为丈夫常年在外飞行，她通常只能待在家里；飞行员的职业决定了聚少离多。
questions.aZh: 因为她通常只能待在家里，而丈夫满世界飞；这正说明飞行员常年在外、聚少离多。
questions.hint: 看课文最后一句 She usually stays at home!

questions.q: Where will he go next week? — He will go to New York next week.
questions.zh: 第 94 课操练：用 will + 地点 + 时间短语回答「他将去哪儿」。
questions.a: Where will they go the week after next? They will go to Geneva the week after next.
questions.aZh: 他们下下个星期去哪儿？他们下下个星期去日内瓦。
questions.hint: next week / next month / the year after next / the week after next 轮换。

drill.q: Where will he/she/they/I go ___? — He/She/They/I will go to ___ ___. / No, ... won't ... She'll ...
drill.zh: 他（她/他们/我）……（时间）将去哪儿？——将去……。（将来时问答；否定更正用 won't ... She'll ...）

日内瓦 — 下下周（他们）
孟买（不是日内瓦）— 明年（海伦）
日内瓦（不是伦敦）— 明天（我）

slots.en: London, not Madrid — next year (Tom and I)
slots.zh: 伦敦（不是马德里）— 明年（汤姆和我）

quiz.q: 与一般将来时连用的时间状语是：
quiz.note: next 系列配将来时；last / ago 系列配过去时。

quiz.q: He flew to Spain a week ago. 中 flew 是哪个动词的过去式？
He has already been to nearly every country. 中 has been to 表示：
quiz.note: has been to 去过；has gone to 去了还没回来。

quiz.q: At the moment, he's in Madrid. 中 at the moment 的意思是：
quiz.note: at the moment 此刻，配一般现在时。

quiz.q: 「他将在下下个星期返回伦敦」正确说法是：
options: He'll return to London the week after next.
He'll return to London the next week after.
He'll return London the week after next.
He returns to London next next week.
quiz.note: return 是不及物动词，须带 to：return to London。

grammar.title: 与一般将来时连用的时间短语
grammar.structure: next + 时间；the + 时间 + after next；in + 一段时间 + 's time
grammar.definition: this week / next week / the week after next、this month / next month / the month after next、this year / next year / the year after next 等常与将来时连用；也可用 in a day's time、in a year's time、in two weeks' time 等。注意过去时中通常用 last 而不是 next。
grammar.usage: He will fly to New York next month.

examples.en: The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 再下个月他将飞往东京。

examples.en: He'll return to London the week after next.
examples.zh: 下下个星期他将返回伦敦。

grammar.title: has been to「去过」
grammar.definition: has been to 表示「曾经去过某地（人已回来）」，常与 already 连用；对比 has gone to 表示「去了某地（人还没回来）」。
grammar.usage: He has already been to nearly every country in the world.

examples.en: He has already been to nearly every country in the world.
examples.zh: 他已经去过世界上几乎每一个国家。

examples.en: I have been to Paris twice.
examples.zh: 我去过巴黎两次。

grammar.title: 一篇短文里的三种时态
grammar.structure: was / flew（过去）— is（现在）— will fly / will return（将来）
grammar.definition: 描述一个人的经历时，三种时态各司其职：过去时讲过去的经历（was in the R.A.F. / flew to Spain a week ago），一般现在时讲现在的状态（he's in Madrid at the moment），将来时讲计划（will fly to New York next month）。时间状语是判断时态的路标。
grammar.usage: 按「过去—现在—将来」的时间线读课文，圈出每个时间状语。

examples.zh: 他曾在皇家空军任职。（过去）

examples.zh: 下个月他将飞往纽约。（将来）
